articles.text: FRIEND: Ciao, sono (nome). Hai cinque minuti?
FRIEND: Hi, this is (first name). Do you have five minutes?
CALLER: Bene, grazie. Do una piccola cena e vorrei invitare te e Paolo.
CALLER: All right, thank you. I'm giving a small dinner and would like to invite you and Paolo.
FRIEND: When are you having it?
CALLER: Next Saturday. Are you free?
FRIEND: Sabato prossimo? Credo proprio di sì.
FRIEND: Next Saturday? I really think so.
CALLER: Bene, allora sabato prossimo verso le otto.
CALLER: Fine, then next Saturday around eight o'clock.
